description: SJC current-progress diagnostic videos: for each model/task pair, record one fixed greedy episode from the seed with the highest latest training-history return for that task.
notes: SJC aim3_rnn was verified with torch 2.3.1, CUDA, OpenCV 4.12.0, Gymnasium 1.3.0, and the canonical Atari evaluator before launch.

The initial tmux launch exited before evaluation because SJC's repository evaluator lacked multi-task video arguments. A later isolated attempt also exposed SJC's missing canonical 18-action wrapper. The isolated r5 evaluator and environment wrapper were preflighted on Skiing and leave SJC's repository code unchanged; r5 retains the four validated videos and resumes only the remaining eleven.
The isolated SJC input leaf contains 15 Amarel metrics histories (181,976,602 bytes) and only nine selected model states. Replay buffers were intentionally not transferred.
For every model/task pair, selection uses the highest finite latest per_env episodic_return_100 across training seeds. Ties prefer the larger history step, then the lower seed number.
Each video metadata records selection-history step/return and the actual checkpoint global_step used. Resumable checkpoints are reduced to model state only for evaluation.
2026-08-26: r5 exited 0. All 15 requested final MP4 files and their metadata were validated one-to-one against the selection manifest.
